title: Feast of Weeks / Pentecost
summary: The Feast of Weeks was a harvest feast later known in Greek as Pentecost.
background: It was associated with firstfruits and thanksgiving for harvest. In Acts 2, Pentecost becomes the setting for the outpouring of the Holy Spirit and gospel proclamation to the nations.
teachingHelp: When teaching Acts 2, connect the feast setting with harvest imagery and the gathering of people from many lands.
